data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Pierus, which means 'rock'. The feminine form is Pierina. The name also symbolizes the pearl, which represents wisdom, purity, and preciousness. The name Pierina carries the meaning “Little Rock, Pearl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Pierina usually hope their child will grow to embody little rock, pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name is derived from the Latin name Pierus, which means 'rock'. In Christianity, the name can be associated with the Rock of Salvation, Jesus Christ.
